manualVisualReview.hopper-retouch.jpg: 六种独立信号算子；强负纹理塑料化，强正纹理强调皱纹；不是自动皮肤缺陷分类。
manualVisualReview.hopper-face-1-1.jpg: 修正后实际复核：额头skinLight过渡减轻，中央曝光力度保留；眼镜/粗分割边界和强瘦脸的邻近纹理变形仍有限制。
manualVisualReview.portrait-face-1-3.jpg: 不同五官与妆容目标有独立效果，强鼻长等极值仍是二维变形，不是3D重建。
manualVisualReview.pose-body-1-1.jpg: 修正后实际复核：完整身体关节的9项可用调节，自动颈长明确不可用；极值腿/腰会带动海岸线等邻近纹理，需要保护/精修。
manualVisualReview.flower-curve-mask-paint.jpg: 非单调曲线、区域布尔组合、组与16种混合呈现不同实际像素；色相/混合强度并非所有情况下等幅改变。
manualVisualReview.flower-hsl-1.jpg: 连续HSL色相/饱和度/亮度变化可见，极端亮度会裁切到黑/白；不是高动态范围无损调色。
manualVisualReview.geometry-protection.jpg: 真实四角透视与保护范围，空白为透明合成背景，液化强度极值出现明显拉伸。
manualVisualReview.photographic-repair.jpg: 小水面细节修复与迭代变化；图块很小，无法据此证明大型语义物体移除质量。

limits: Photographic sweeps use at most 320px edge; they do not validate 16MP quality or mobile latency.
Native analysis is reused from the recorded real CPU inference after full source hash validation; no new browser inference is claimed.

Actual manual viewing is recorded per reviewer in v4-visual-review-part1.md through part4.md and v4-visual-review-fixes.md; generated hashes do not replace human viewing or prove per-pixel commercial retouch quality.
Finite control sampling is not exhaustive coverage of all parameter combinations.
V4 automatic neckLength is unavailable: no anatomically constrained head/neck/shoulder deformation is implemented. Stored primitive playback and legacy V3 remain unchanged.
Face-size-dependent inward feather improves the outer forehead transition; coarse segmentation and protected-feature boundaries, including glasses, remain limitations.
No source photos or model weights are embedded in this report.
